_why_one_claim: R only, so there is no agreement claim; check.py records it as untested. RECOVERY asks whether the estimate is close to the parameter the fixture used; harness/survival2_examples.test.py also compares it with the full cohort's estimate.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: cohort hazard 0.03 a year x 1.8 if exposed

agreement._note: In place of a second language: the full cohort's Cox estimate (0.602, never available in a real study) must lie within two case-cohort standard errors of the case-cohort estimate (0.700, SE 0.135), and an unweighted Cox model on the sample must differ from the weighted one.

recovery.claim: the case-cohort log hazard ratio is close to the fixture's

calibration.limits: Measured in R by harness/survival2_examples.test.py over seeds 0 to 99. The committed fixture misses by 0.112.
